description: Football clubs of Egypt, including Egyptian Premier League and historic sides. Each record carries the canonical Latin-transliterated club name, founded year where the upstream registry publishes it, host city, alternative spellings (aliases), and — for clubs that appeared in the Egyptian Premier League 2012/13 season — the Arabic-script name joined from the upstream openfootball language-mapping file. Sourced from the openfootball/clubs registry.
